note: Oklahoma Voice's 2026 general election guide (each legislative candidate was invited to send a campaign website link) was read for every legislative and statewide race in this part; it gave no site for Judd Strom, David Nelson, Leslie Hellebuyck, Carolyn Womack-Bielich, Clay Staires, Adam Martin, Melissa Provenzano, Tegan Malone or Chris Jones, and HD 59 is not on the ballot. The session's shared web-search allowance ran out partway through this part, so the county, judicial and Bartlesville candidates were looked for only on government sites that answered: okcounties.org has pages for Mayes County but none for Caddo, Grady, Okmulgee or Pushmataha. No Oklahoma party page calls anything an endorsement for these races (see ballot/lean/ok_endorsements.json), so no endorsed_by is recorded. Adam Martin (HD 72, Republican) shares a name with the 2024 HD 72 Democratic candidate and 2022 Democratic nominee for the 1st Congressional District, but no page tied the two, so nothing is recorded for him. Tegan Malone was the 2024 HD 95 Democratic nominee by secondary accounts, but the official results site refuses scripts, so no past_party is recorded.
